metadata.title: Data Core

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for defining authoritative ownership, accountability, and baseline trust properties for institutional data.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Enterprise data assets, datasets, records, data services, and data-producing systems.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Foundational pattern defining non-negotiable trust invariants that apply to all institutional data, regardless of storage location or use case.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Data Core aligns with NIST SP 800-53 controls governing ownership, accountability, access, and auditability.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Institutional data frequently crosses system and organizational boundaries and requires explicit authority and responsibility definition.

metadata.remarks: Data Core defines the baseline trust properties required for any institutional data. These invariants ensure that all data is attributable to an owner, limited to an authorized scope, protected against unauthorized manipulation, and observable for governance and investigation. This pattern deliberately excludes data classification, encryption, loss prevention, consent, and retention mechanics, which are defined by complementary Secure Data patterns.

components.title: Data Ownership and Accountability
components.description: Ensures each dataset has an accountable owner responsible for its accuracy, protection, and authorized use.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Masquerading or misrepresentation of data authority or ownership.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong identity binding ensures clear accountability for data ownership.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Policies define data ownership and accountability responsibilities.
Data ownership is attributable to authenticated identities.

components.title: Authoritative Scope and Purpose
components.description: Defines the intended scope, context, and authoritative use of data prior to protection or dissemination.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Collection or use of data outside its legitimate or approved scope.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit scope definition and governance prevent unauthorized use or expansion.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Data is used only for defined and approved purposes.

components.title: Baseline Data Integrity
components.description: Protects data against unauthorized modification, corruption, or loss prior to application of classification or encryption controls.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Unauthorized modification or corruption of institutional data.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Integrity validation and protection preserve baseline data trustworthiness.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Integrity mechanisms detect and prevent unauthorized data modification.

components.title: Data Activity Observability
components.description: Provides auditability of data creation, modification, access, and authorized dissemination.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Deletion or suppression of evidence related to unauthorized data activity.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging and review enable accountability and investigation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Data-related events are defined and logged.
Audit review supports detection of inappropriate data use.
